prompt: The drive had stopped. What belongs in the report?
promptZh: 驅動端當時已停機，回報中應有哪些資料？

options.text: Only the current shown after the restart
options.zh: 只有重啟後顯示的電流
options.whyZh: 事後重啟的電流不能描述卡料時的狀態。

options.text: The line number and current, but not the part position
options.zh: 產線編號和電流，不含零件位置
options.whyZh: 已停機要寫明狀態，仍應回報最後位置。

options.text: Only the position, since the line number stays the same
options.zh: 只需位置，因為產線編號沒變
options.whyZh: 無論當時驅動端狀態如何，都要送線號。

options.text: The line number, position, and a note that the drive had stopped
options.zh: 產線編號、位置，以及驅動端當時已停機的註記
options.whyZh: 仍回報線號及位置；電流欄改以停機註記代替。

explanationZh: 仍回報線號及位置；電流欄改以停機註記代替。
evidence: Give the line number and the last position reading on your screen. | If it had already stopped, write that down instead of sending a current reading.
